item.title: Trump delays Xi meeting as Iran conflict lets US strong-arm China’s oil supply
item.summary: The Iran conflict is disrupting oil flows China relies on as Trump delays a planned Xi meeting, raising new questions about leverage and the broader U.S.–China relationship.

item.title: Maine Senate candidate cites combat trauma when confronted on 'terrible' posts about sexual assault
item.summary: Maine Senate candidate Graham Platner cited trauma from his combat deployments when pressed on old Reddit posts about rape, as Gov. Janet Mills targets him with attack ads.

item.title: Air Canada passenger says pilot 'did the best thing he could,' describes deadly impact
item.summary: Passenger Jack Cabot says the Air Canada pilot "did the best thing he could" before the deadly collision with a fire truck on the runway of LaGuardia Airport.

item.title: Obama intel chief angered president at meeting by asking if he'd tolerate Iran having nuclear weapon
item.summary: Newly released oral histories revealed that former DNI Dennis Blair confronted President Obama over Iran’s nuclear policy and was later sidelined.

item.title: Former Biden spox complains easy Trump press access influences 'giddy' reporters
item.summary: Former Biden press secretary Jen Psaki gave drawbacks to reporters' easy access to President Donald Trump during her recent "Pod Save America" appearance.

item.title: Illegal immigrant charged in college student’s murder has court hearing postponed after latest arrest
item.summary: Jose Medina, a Venezuelan illegal immigrant released under Biden, is accused of fatally shooting Loyola University Chicago student Sheridan Gorman, 18.

item.title: Megan Rapinoe praises Iranian women's soccer team's 'bravery' after facing criticism
item.summary: Former U.S. soccer star Megan Rapinoe finally spoke out about the Iranian women's soccer team's plight after protesting during matches in Australia.

item.title: Palantir executive says AI enabling rapid battlefield planning and high-speed US strike operations
item.summary: Palantir CTO Shyam Sankar describes AI military tech as an "Iron Man suit" for troops, saying human judgment still drives all battlefield decisions.

item.title: ATM jackpotting attacks surge across the US
item.summary: The FBI warns of rising ATM jackpotting attacks, where hackers use malware to force ATM machines to dispense cash without authorization.

item.title: 'Call a Boomer' payphones help cure loneliness, spark friendships across generations
item.summary: The "Call a Boomer" payphone project aims to fight loneliness by connecting younger and older adults through candid, cross-generational conversations.
